title: Synthetic PB4T feasibility planner
description: Offline weekly planning demonstration with deterministic hard constraints and local proposal review. No operational integrations, departmental agents, SFTRM engine or global optimization.

components.label: Weekly request and policy editor
components.description: Labeled synthetic roster, availability, operating windows, requests and candidate-time controls; saved and unsaved state.

components.label: Bounded feasibility engine
components.description: Deterministic explicit-candidate search with fixed personnel, qualifications, exclusive resources, rest and horizon duty limits. Standalone classic-script core embedded in HTML; Node adapter exposes the same actual functions.

components.label: Independent schedule audit
components.description: Independently checks all interval pairs, constraint boundaries, required-request coverage and duty totals before a result is reviewable.

components.label: Weekly board and personnel loading
components.description: Original competing requests beside proposed allocations; editable candidate selection, numeric loading and heatmap legend; honest failure and search-limit states.

components.label: Local draft and review record
components.description: Versioned synthetic draft and last proposal in localStorage when available. Explicit save/discard, stale-review protection, local acceptance and JSON export; no server or identity integration.
